pages.text: $(italic)Aggressive, hungry, and hits like a falling anvil. Orcs excel in sustained melee at the cost of resource drain.$()$(br2)$(bold)Orcish Endurance$(): +20% max HP.$(br2)$(bold)Orcish Strength$(): +10% melee damage.$(br2)$(bold)Battle Fury$(): +10% attack speed. Pairs especially well with Berserker's Blood Fury.

pages.title: Traits (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Bloodlust$(): the hungrier you are, the harder you hit: up to +20% attack damage on an empty food bar.$(br2)$(bold)Ravenous$(): $(warn)you burn food fast$() (extra exhaustion every 4 seconds). Always eat before fights.$(br2)$(bold)Next: pair with Berserker or Samurai and keep food hotkeyed. You'll burn through it.$()
